It is concerning that your blood work and cultures are normal despite your persistent fever and history of unpasteurized dairy consumption. To rule out other causes, have you had any recent urinary symptoms, such as burning or frequency, or any respiratory issues like a cough?

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal urinalysis and urine culture help rule out a urinary tract infection. Given your history of unpasteurized dairy consumption and current symptoms, I need to check for other signs of systemic infection. Have you experienced any muscle aches, joint pain, or a stiff neck?
